summary: Completed Iter67 backend+frontend validation for release artist metadata fallback, admin UPC/ISRC panel behavior, new labels.package RBAC role model, and real manual package-change workflow using isolated fixtures on public preview.
critical_code_review_comments: release_list_metadata.enrich_release_list is batched (tracks + artists) and avoids per-release N+1 calls by design; dedupe logic preserves first-seen case/order.
Dedicated package endpoint enforces atomic audit + revision increment via guarded update_one and rejects stale revision writes without duplicate history append.
ProtectedRoute admin fallback depends on permission payload from /auth/login; current flow is valid for admin_package_manager because user.is_admin is populated from backend role enrichment.
seed_data_creation: Created isolated Iter67 UI fixture label + temporary package-manager admin; both were cleaned. Credentials were appended then marked REMOVED in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Iter67 scoped checks passed on live preview. Fixture cleanup completed (label/user/releases/tracks/admin user removed) and temporary credentials retired. Reuse /app/tests/iter67_ui_fixture.py seed/cleanup plus /app/tests/iter67_ui_playwright.py for regression reruns.
rca of the issue: No blocking defects reproduced in Iter67 scope. One environment nuance observed during auth playbook check: public OPTIONS preflight can be intercepted upstream, so CORS credential contract was validated successfully against direct backend port 8001 as recommended by /app/auth_testing.md.
